messages:
Elena (People Ops): Quick People Ops update — please read when you have 2-3 minutes. Effective May 1 we’re making three changes: 1) PTO accrual adjustment for new hires, 2) parental leave extended to 16 weeks fully paid, and 3) a streamlined travel fast-track for low-cost conferences. Also: complete the Code of Conduct refresher by May 15. Full policy doc: https://redwood-internal.company/policies/people-updates. React with :white_check_mark: when read.

Raj (Eng): Thanks! Quick q — what's the new PTO accrual for hires in yr1?

Elena (People Ops): New hires accrue PTO at 1.5 days/month for the first 12 months (was 1.25). After 12 months standard accrual applies. Rollover cap unchanged at 15 days.

Ava (Product): Does the parental leave change apply to folks currently on leave or only new leaves starting May 1?

Elena (People Ops): Applies to any leave starting on or after May 1. If you’re currently on leave and want to switch to the new policy, DM me and we'll handle it case-by-case.

Tom (Finance): Travel fast-track — is the <$3k limit per person or per trip? Who signs off?

Elena (People Ops): Under $3k per trip, per person. Approval: manager + finance fast-track (no Exec review). Use form: https://redwood-internal.company/forms/travel-fasttrack.

Nora (Recruiting): Recruiter travel budgets for on-campus events are <$1k but frequent — any change?

Elena (People Ops): No change to recruiting budgets. Fast-track applies to individual trips; recurring programmatic spend should go through recruiting finance for bulk approval.

Raj (Eng): Confirm rollover cap stays 15 days?

Elena (People Ops): Confirmed — stays 15 days. We kept it to encourage regular time off.

Ava (Product): How do we confirm completion of the Code of Conduct refresher? Quiz or auto-record?

policy-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: Code of Conduct refresher assigned to all staff. Complete by May 15. Link: https://redwood-internal.company/learning/coc-refresh. Completion recorded automatically.

Elena (People Ops): If you have access issues DM me or open a ticket in #help. Short all-hands Q&A on May 6 at 10am PT for questions.

Tom (Finance): For reimbursements, keep receipts and submit via expense flow within 30 days. Fast-track trips still require receipts.

Nora (Recruiting): Recruiting will update offer templates today to reflect parental leave change. Heads-up to hiring managers.

Elena (People Ops): FAQ highlights: Effective May 1; Parental leave 16 weeks paid (birth/adoption), applies at leave start; PTO yr1 accrual 1.5 days/month; rollover cap 15 days; Travel fast-track < $3k per person/trip; Code of Conduct refresher due May 15. Use Exception Request form for large spends: https://redwood-internal.company/forms/exception-request. Reply "one-pager" if you want a short summary for your team.

Raj (Eng): one-pager

Elena (People Ops): Dropping a one-pager now and pinning in #people-ops. "Thanks!"
